study.note: Joined book starts when all three coins exist. Solana's own tape starts later than Bitcoin and Ethereum, so the earlier Bitcoin and Ethereum bars are kept in the per-coin audit and left out of the book. Missing means absent 15-minute slots between the first and last bar. Duplicate means the same timestamp stored twice. Costs stay 0.1% taker and 5 bps slippage, doubled only in the fee stress. Seed 20261114.
study.regimeDefinition: Regime is declared up front and is not a skeptic gate. A trade is bull when Bitcoin's close on the entry bar is more than 5% above its close 1,920 bars earlier (20 days of 15-minute bars), bear when it is more than 5% below, and sideways otherwise. Bars before that lookback count as sideways.
study.yearlyDefinition: A yearly book starts flat on the first 15-minute bar of that UTC year inside the sample and ends on the last. A year with at least 1,920 bars is counted. Beating V-Pro on that year is a yearly win. The skeptic still uses its own four anchored folds. The yearly split does not replace them.

luck.definition: Each holdout trade keeps its coin, its side, and how many bars it was open. The entry bar is redrawn inside the holdout so that one coin's trades do not overlap. Entry is that bar's open. Exit is the open that many bars later, or the same bar's close when the trade did not last a full bar. The same costs apply. A draw matches the candidate when its timing profit is at least the candidate's own timing profit. This is not the book's stop-to-stop profit, and it is not a skeptic gate.
